What the app can do and how to set it up

Switches iGO navigator skins with one tap — day, night, winter, whatever you have, 2 to 4 of them.

• A skin is switched on by renaming the save and ux folders: nothing is copied or deleted.
• If a rename fails, the folders are put back as they were.
• You can add several iGO navigators, each with its own folder and skins.
• After a switch the app can launch the navigator or close itself.

The active skin lives in save and ux, the others in numbered folders:

IGO/
 ├ sys.txt
 ├ save/    ux/    ← active
 ├ save_2/  ux_2/
 ├ save_3/  ux_3/
 └ save_4/  ux_4/

Every skin needs a save.ch file with one line, its number: skin_1, skin_2 and so on. It tells the app which skin is on, and it moves together with its folder.

If save.ch is in ux rather than save, only ux is switched.

Add this section to sys.txt in the iGO folder:

[skin_changer]
skin_quantity = 4
skin_1 = "Day"
skin_2 = "Night"
skin_3 = "Winter"
skin_4 = "Contrast"

• skin_quantity — how many buttons to show: 2, 3 or 4.
• skin_1…skin_4 — button labels. Without a name the button says “Skin N”.
• Without the section the number of skins is taken from the folders found.
• UTF-8, UTF-16 and Windows-1251 all work. Other sections are left untouched.

If the device has two or three iGO builds, for example Primo and NextGen, add each one: Settings → Navigators → Add navigator, and choose its iGO folder and app.

Buttons for the navigators then appear at the top of the main screen. Pick one and the skin buttons and colours switch to it. The app remembers the last choice.

You can name a navigator yourself, otherwise the name of its app is used.

1. Prepare the skin folders and save.ch files as described above.
2. Open Settings, pick the navigator and tap iGO folder. Find the folder that holds save and ux, tap “Use this folder” and allow access.
3. Optionally choose the Navigator package and turn on Launch iGO after switching.
4. Go back to the main screen and tap the skin you want.

Close the navigator before switching: a running iGO may keep the skin files open.

• “save.ch not found” — wrong folder, or save.ch has no skin_N line.
• “Folders not found” on a button — the save_N and ux_N folders of that skin are missing.
• The skin did not change — the app puts the folders back and shows the failed step. Make sure the navigator is closed.
• No memory card in the folder picker — turn it on in the picker’s “⋮” menu.
• The device feels slow — turn the animations off in the settings.
